name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default because it reduces eye strain during long sessions and aligns with the competitive analysis showing dark themes improve readability for data-heavy interfaces. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode, but we’ll mitigate this with a one-click toggle in the top-right corner for instant switching.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The real risk isn’t user preference—it’s that a one-click toggle still assumes users *know* to use it, and that’s a failure of visibility. A better alternative is to make the theme a persistent setting tied to system preference, not a manual switch. Settle it by testing whether users even notice the toggle exists in the first place.

name: Facet
text:
Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default but force it to sync with the user’s system preference on first launch—no toggle. This guarantees visibility and liveliness from day one by eliminating the need for users to discover or remember a switch. The trade-off is that users who *want* a dark theme but work in a light environment (or vice versa) will see a mismatch until they adjust their system settings, but that’s a one-time friction, not a recurring usability tax.

text: Pane: The real risk isn’t user control—it’s that forcing system sync removes the *user’s* choice entirely, making the interface feel rigid.
